title: LYA Platform Adapter
description: The only way LYA talks to a platform (08-PLATFORM-ROLES.md 3.2). No platform is imported directly by L3/L4 code, so swapping Notion/Supabase/Turso is an adapter change, not a brain change.

egress_class.description: private_never is refused by the transport layer, not by convention (ADR-008).

reserve.description: Requests held back so an automation cannot spend the last one and lock LYA out.

data_policy_checked_at.description: Required before this adapter may receive grounded private memory (ADR-008).

degradation.description: What happens when it is unreachable: 'read local', 'abstain', 'queue for later'.
